name: drive-launch-video
description: Launch video for Drive, built with HyperFrames (drive#651).
//: HyperFrames is invoked by the pinned version below, not from the repo's node_modules: `hyperframes` is not a package the repo depends on, and a composition's own toolchain must not change when the site's dependencies do. The version is pinned because the render has to repeat. Run these from this folder. The render is local: HyperFrames drives this machine's Chrome and ffmpeg, so it needs no account, no cloud service and no credit.
